mentions.name: Cushman Custom Golf
mentions.description: A side hobby business handcrafting custom golf putters on antique machinery in a home garage, growing an Instagram following for its work while the maker learns how to run the business side.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been trying to build a golf side hobby business making putters on antique machinery in my garage. Have grown to get some pretty steady traction on instagram, have realized I am not a businessman in all of this, so a lot of learning.
